# 对角化和矩阵乘幂

```{python}
from sympy import Matrix, Rational
from IPython.display import display

A = Matrix([
    [Rational(4, 5), Rational(3, 10)],
    [Rational(1, 5), Rational(7, 10)],
])

S, D = A.diagonalize()

display(A)
display(S)
display(D)

# A = S D S^-1
display(S * D * S.inv())

# D = S^-1 A S
display(S.inv() * A * S)
```

[向量$a^Ta aa^t$是有关系的，矩阵$A^TA AA^t$是没关系的？](../appendices/22.md#向量ata-aat是有关系的矩阵ata-aat是没关系的)

```{python}
from sympy import Matrix
from IPython.display import display

a = Matrix([1, 1, 1, 1])
b = Matrix([2, 2, 2, 2])
display(a.T * b)
display(a * b.T)
```
```{python}
from sympy import Matrix
from IPython.display import display


A = Matrix([
    [1, 1, 1, 1],
    [2, 2, 2, 2],
])
display(A.T * A)
display(A * A.T)

display(A[0, :])
display(A.row(0))  # 取出第一行
display(A[:, 0])
display(A.col(0))  # 取出第一列
```

[`eig(rand(10,10)) ` sympy 能实现吗？](../appendices/22.md#eigrand1010-sympy-能实现吗)

```{python}
from sympy import Matrix
from IPython.display import display

A = Matrix([
    [2, 1],
    [0, 2],
])

display(*A.eigenvects())

A = Matrix([
    [0, 1],
    [0, 0],
])

display(*A.eigenvects())
```
